mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM `order` WHERE status = '已完成' AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT b.title AS title, COUNT(oi.book_id) AS cnt FROM order_item oi JOIN book b ON oi.book_id = b.book_id GROUP BY b.book_id, b.title ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM `order` GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 6
